title: Feature Section 117
short_description: A features section structured in a three-column grid under a central header with a tagline, title, and paragraph. It uses a parent list with hidden overflow, built-in divider lines, and a 1px gap to define the borders of the child cards. Each card features an icon at the top, a title, and descriptive text, with an interactive zoom effect (scale 1.1) and background transparency when the cursor hovers over it or it receives focus, simulating a selected state.
